text:
[LGRA.7.1] Series productions:

```
series_decl       ::= 'series' slot_ref block_opts? ':' NEWLINE
                      INDENT docstring? series_line+ DEDENT

slot_ref          ::= (NAME '.')? NAME

block_opts        ::= '(' block_kwarg (',' block_kwarg)* ')'
block_kwarg       ::= 'by' ':' (NAME | 'none')
                    | 'capacity' ':' INT_LIT               ;; LSER.13.14
                    | 'nulls' ':' ('skip' | 'hold' | 'zero') ;; LNUL.8.6

series_line       ::= agg_list time_model accuracy? gap_policy? ('as' NAME)? NEWLINE
agg_list          ::= agg_name (',' agg_name)*
agg_name          ::= NAME                           ;; per LSER.16
gap_policy        ::= 'gap' ('hold' | 'zero' | 'skip') ;; integral only — LSER.13.5.1
time_model        ::= 'all_time'
                    | 'sliding'  duration
                    | 'tumbling' duration
                    | 'sample'   INT_LIT
accuracy          ::= 'exact'                    ;; all five parse and are
                    | 'tolerance'  FLOAT_LIT     ;; then REJECTED — see below
                    | 'confidence' FLOAT_LIT
                    | 'delta'      FLOAT_LIT
                    | 'bound' 'deterministic'
```

The `accuracy` alternatives **parse**, and every one of them is then rejected
by the validator ([LSER.15.1]). They are in the grammar so
the diagnostic can name the phrase the author wrote.
